anomalies.observed: The net /PIN18 contains J1 pin 18, J2 pin 18, R3 pin 2, R9 pin 1, and R10 pin 1. R9 and R10 also connect the selected channel-1 bus pins /PWM1_C1 (J1/J2 pin 19) and /PWM1_C2 (J1/J2 pin 21) to this same net.
anomalies.expected: The specification says R9-R12 select which M5Stack bus pin, pin 19 or pin 21 for channel 1, supplies PWM1. The PWM1 common net should be isolated and connected to the servo only through R3, not permanently tied to M5Stack bus pin 18.

evidence.quote: R9–R12 | 0 Ω (jumpers) | Select which M5Stack bus pin (pin 19/21 for ch.1, pin 20/22 for ch.2) supplies PWM1/PWM2

anomalies.impact: Bus pin 18 is permanently tied to the PWM1/servo signal path; when R9 or R10 is populated it is also shorted to bus pin 19 or 21. This can conflict with any use of those GPIO pins, corrupt pass-through to a lower module, and may damage the M5Stack or cause incorrect servo control.

parsed.summary: Most of the board matches the specification, but the PWM1 common net is tied to M5Stack bus pin 18, which is not one of the intended PWM selection pins and creates an unintended bridged net.
